dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install Python dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Install system dependencies for Flutter development
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    unzip \
    git \
    xz-utils \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Flutter SDK
RUN git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /usr/local/flutter
ENV PATH="\$PATH:/usr/local/flutter/bin"

# Pre-download Flutter dependencies
RUN flutter precache

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Set default command
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Flutter DevOps environment ready')"]
explanation: This configuration provides a Python 3.9 slim environment optimized for Flutter DevOps tasks. The requirements.txt includes essential Python packages for utility scripts, HTTP requests, configuration parsing, and system monitoring. The Dockerfile sets up a complete Flutter development environment with system dependencies, Flutter SDK installation, and dependency pre-caching. The 'util' import suggests utility scripting needs, while 'breakpad' indicates potential crash reporting integration, though breakpad is typically a C++ dependency handled separately from Python requirements.
